|skill        = E
|icon         = false
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for 16% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.1}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he deals against enemy champions.
|icon2        = Umbral Dash.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction.
|description3 = ''Umbral Dash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Aatrox's''' basic attack timer and can be cast during his other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''
|cast time    = none
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|75 - 300|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}|{{tt|500|Maximum extended dash distance across terrain}}}}
|speed        = {{dv|{{tt|800|Dash speed, slightly higher when measured}}|{{tt|1340|Maximum increased dash speed, when dashing through wide terrain}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|9 to 5}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Self
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|terraingrace = true
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* The {{tip|dash}} distance can be extended to up-to 500 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall.
** This may upscale his dash speed so that the dash takes the same total time as the standard maximum-range dash.
* If ''Umbral Dash'' is cast towards a movement command's end point, ''Umbral Dash'' will re-issue a movement command to that point when the dash ends.
** He will be unable to buffer any commands during the dash if it is casted this way. {{bug|1}}
* '''Aatrox's''' model darkens for {{fd|1.5}} seconds upon casting ''Umbral Dash'', which is a remnant of an {{as|attack damage}} buff he received before it got removed in [[V9.9]].
